title: Wind Shear Model
text: Calculate wind shear conditions, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Units} sets Wind shear units Metric; {Flight phase}, {Wind speed at 20 ft altitude (kts)} and {Wind direction at 20 ft altitude (degrees clockwise from north)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Wind shear units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Flight phase
params.values: Flight phase Category C - Terminal Flight Phase (default) | Other

params.name: Wind direction at 20 ft altitude (degrees clockwise from north)
